chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us, saying: Abu Sa'id al-Adamy narrated to us, saying: Ali ibn al-Zayat narrated to us from Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, from someone he mentioned, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), saying:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'We were with the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) when the delegation of Abdul Qays arrived, greeted, and then placed a large quantity of dates before him. The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) asked:

key_terms.الْبَرْنِيُّ: A specific variety of high-quality dates
key_terms.جَلَّةَ تَمْرٍ: A large quantity or heap of dates
key_terms.عَبْدُ الْقَيْس: A prominent Arab tribe known for their early acceptance of Islam
key_terms.يُخْبِلُ الشَّيْطَانَ: To weaken or disable Satan (literally: to break its hand)

ai.seo_question: What are the nine spiritual and physical benefits of Barni dates according to the Prophet Muhammad in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal* highlights the spiritual and physical virtues of Barni dates, linking their consumption to both bodily health and spiritual elevation through the Prophet’s revelation to Gabriel. It underscores the Shia emphasis on the interconnection between physical well-being and closeness to God, where mundane acts like eating become acts of worship when performed with awareness. The mention of 'repelling Satan' and 'bringing one closer to God' reflects the holistic view of human nature in Shia tradition, where the body and soul are mutually influential.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 9-8 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted Abu Sa’id al-Adamy, on the authority of Ali ibn al-Zyat, on the authority of Ubaydullah ibn Abdullah, on the authority of someone who linked it up to Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) that the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (MGB) said, “I was with the Prophet (MGB) when Abdul Qays’s representatives came with a sac full of dates and placed it in front of the Prophet (MGB). Then the Prophet (MGB) asked, ‘Is this charity or a gift?’ They replied, ‘O Prophet of God! It is a gift.’ He (MG) asked them, ‘What kind of dates is it?’ They said, ‘It is Al-Barni dates.’

Then the Prophet (MGB) said, ‘There are nine characteristics in dates. Indeed Gabriel informed me that eating dates has nine benefits: 1. It eliminates pain. 2. It makes your breath smell good. 3. It helps digest food. 4. It improves hearing and vision. 5. It increases sex drive. 6. It strengthens the back. 7. It cuts off the hands of Satan. 8. It brings man closer to God. 9. It takes man farther away from Satan.’”
